Task Description: Audited all 14 mobile app screen designs from 'VidyaSetu Student & Parent Mobile App'; mapped student vs parent role boundaries, multi-child switching requirements, and child-scoped API architecture.
Authored comprehensive Parent Application API Specification covering Modules 0 through P7, RBAC permissions, and multi-child relationship data flows.

Created and executed database migration seeding 13 granular parent permissions (parent.profile.view, parent.home.view, parent.academic.view, parent.attendance.view, parent.exam.view, parent.homework.view, parent.fee.view, etc.) assigned to role_id 7.
Enhanced authentication services for parent login, JWT token issuance with guardian context & multi-child ID, refresh tokens, forgot password OTP, reset password, and change password.
Implemented parent profile view, update profile details, and profile photo upload endpoints with validation.
Configured dedicated Postman collection 'Vidyasetu_Parent_App_APIs.postman_collection.json' with collection variables, dynamic token extraction, and child context chaining.

Built aggregated family home dashboard (GET /home), linked children list (GET /children), and single-child deep-dive overview (GET /children/:studentId/overview) with attendance, academic snapshot, and upcoming agenda.
Implemented guardian authorization middleware (requireParentAndChildAccess) to strictly enforce student-guardian links at DB level and prevent IDOR/cross-child data leaks.

Implemented child timetable (today/calendar), attendance tracker (summary/monthly history/subject-wise), upcoming exams, completed past exams with server-side pagination, scorecard breakdown details, and homework assignments with attachments.

Implemented child fee summary (gross fee, concessions, net, paid %, outstanding balance, next due date) and paginated installment invoices with fee component breakdown heads (Tuition, Activity, Library & Tech fee).
Resolved MySQL ONLY_FULL_GROUP_BY compliance in academic snapshot queries, sanitized JSON array parsing for file attachments, verified server-side pagination, and ran full automated test suite.
